item.text: The current DOL PDF exposes the seasonally adjusted insured-unemployment history in thousands through week ending August 1, 2026. I’ll use that exact variant for anchors and scale values to the registered `millions` unit.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import statistics
vals=[1.771,1.785,1.771,1.786,1.800,1.812,1.806,1.821,1.798,1.789,1.777,1.799,1.777]
changes=[b-a for a,b in zip(vals,vals[1:])]
print(changes)
print('n',len(changes),'mean',statistics.mean(changes),'pstdev',statistics.pstdev(changes),'stdev',statistics.stdev(changes))
print('1.28*stdev',1.28*statistics.stdev(changes))
print('last',vals[-1], 'last+3*mean', vals[-1]+3*statistics.mean(changes))
# include initial claims recent changes maybe not
PY"
